name: Fish, Piranha (Mature)
source: Book of Beasts: Monsters of the River Nations
book: Book of Beasts: Monsters of the River Nations

facets.bk: Book of Beasts: Monsters of the River Nations

body:
This sharp-toothed fish hunts down food with deadly efficiency.

Piranha, Mature
CR 1

XP 400
N Small animal (aquatic)
Init +5; Senses low-light vision, scent; Perception +7

DEFENSE

AC 14, touch 12, flat-footed 13 (+1 Dex, +2 natural, +1 size)
hp 13 (3d8)
Fort +3, Ref +5, Will +2

OFFENSE

Speed swim 40 ft.
Melee +1 (1d4-1 plus 1 Con bleed)

STATISTICS

Str 9, Dex 14, Con 10, Int 1, Wis 12, Cha 5
Base Atk +2; CMB +0; CMD 12
Feats Alertness, Improved Initiative
Skills Perception +7; Racial Swim +8

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Scent (Ex)

A piranha can smell a warm-blooded creature in the water up to 100 ft. away and fresh blood in the water up to 300 ft. away.

ECOLOGY

Environment temperate or warm aquatic
Organization solitary, pair or school (3-10)
Treasure none

Despite being as tall as a halfling, a mature piranha could devour a halfling in minutes. The piranha’s appetite surpasses even a goblin in sheer ability in how much food it can eat for its body size. With its ability to smell blood from 300 feet away, more arrive shortly after a piranha gets it first bite.
